question: The effective annual rate of interest corresponding to a nominal rate of 2% per annum, payable half-yearly, is:
solution:
Given:

Nominal rate = 2% p.a.

Compounded half-yearly

Concept:

Effective annual rate = (1 + Nominal rate / Number of compounding periods)Number of compounding periods - 1
